address: 46F, Breeze Nan Shan, 17 Songzhi Road, Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: The pristine room affords stunning views of the city and Taipei 101. The three set menus highlight the well-honed skills and boundless creativity of the kitchen team covering various styles of Sichuan cuisine, ranging from home cooking to ancient recipes for imperial officials. You may also create your own set menu according to your preferences. Signatures like cabbage in consommé and snowflake chicken with lobster are subtle and delicate.
